front.title: DNS-SD Data Block: An Encoding for Non-IP Transports

abstract.t: The DNS-SD Data Block (DDB) is a compact, Type-Length-Value (TLV) encoded container for conveying DNS-Based Service Discovery (DNS-SD) service information over non-IP transports used by short-range peer- to-peer or proximity-based advertisement and discovery technologies, such as the Bluetooth Low Energy Transport Discovery Service or Near Field Communication (NFC) Verb NFC Data Exchange Format (NDEF) records.
